basis: East-meadow measured option in inland-pond-options.json; source-only, no runtime/manifests changed.
artIntent: An inland fishing basin with a compressed higher northwest cutbank below the lobby, a focused eastern reed cove, a southern turf headland separating that cove from a broad southwest arrival bay, and localized exposed soil. Reserve distinct shore access for every fishing tier. No uniformly spaced perimeter furniture or continuous mineral collar.

outlyingBankStudy.basis: Actual terrain, footing, water, resource and native-collision site survey; pond-outlying-bank-sites03. Southwestern site has 0.4132m sampled roof-envelope ground relief without a new terrain grade.
outlyingBankStudy.artIntent: A modest open timber banking outpost set back on the southwestern turf shoulder, serving both landings without occupying the fishing edge. Keep the broad pond view and free meadow circulation open. Court-specific worn arrival, planting, visual distinction from the town bank and native art remain to be composed and qualified.

dockStudy.character: Short broad timber landing with an open fishing end, stout weathered posts and restrained supply props outside the walking lane.
Offset quiet-water jetty with a small side fishing platform, low partial rails and reed-framed views.
